{{Top|leg}}
The '''chiroptix''' was a creature from [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] with a keen sense of hearing. This creature gave its name to technique used by the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] known as "[[Ears of the Chiroptix]]."

==Behind the scenes==
In his endnotes for the ''Book of Sith'', [[Daniel Wallace]] said he intended the chiroptix to be a bat-like creature, hence modifying the scientific classification for bats (Order: Chiroptera).<ref name="BOS endnotes">{{Blogspot|subdomain=geekosity|url=2012/04/endnotes-for-star-wars-book-of-sith.html|name=Daniel Wallaces Geekosity|text=Endnotes for Star Wars: Book of Sith (part 4)}}</ref>
